$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # two-types
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    what ran, in order:
        grid-parse ran on b
        format's probe ran
        format ran on b
        parse ran on a
        format's probe ran
        format ran on a
